description: Defines the interface for user management in the Starboard platform, including user handles, properties, and retrieval functions.

methods.name: SbUserIsValid
methods.description: Checks if a user handle is valid.

methods.name: SbUserGetSignedIn
methods.description: Retrieves a list of signed-in users.

methods.name: SbUserGetPropertySize
methods.description: Gets the size of a user's property value.

methods.name: SbUserGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value for a user.
